sources.ERA5: Copernicus ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo archive API (scripts/emulator/cache/{id}.json)
sources.POWER: NASA POWER Daily API, community AG, PRECTOTCORR (scripts/emulator/cache_power_app/{id}.json)
sources.CHIRPS: CHIRPS v2.0 daily rainfall (UCSB CHC) via ClimateSERV dataset 0, mean of a +-0.03 deg box (scripts/emulator/cache_rain/{id}_chirps.json)

definitions.annualMm: agricultural year Y: 1 April Y to 31 March Y+1
definitions.mayOctMm: 1 May to 31 October of year Y
definitions.julAugMm: 1 July to 31 August of year Y (the canicula)
definitions.longestDrySpellJunSep: longest run of consecutive days with rain < 1 mm between 1 June and 30 September of year Y
definitions.missing: a statistic is null when any day of its period has no value; no day is filled. Agricultural years with any missing day are listed in yearsExcluded and are not simulated for that source and site.
